CGMagazine
With three great games and tons of goodies, the Joe & Mac: Retro Collection is an excellent assortment of three prehistoric platformers (and I don’t mean that just because they’re retro).
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Oct 30, 2026
75
Gaming Boulevard
Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a bit uneven, but I still enjoyed seeing how different these three games are. Caveman Ninja is still great fun if you can deal with the difficulty, Congo’s Caper is easily the odd one out, and Lost in the Tropics was the game that worked best for me because it reminded me so much of the SNES platformers I grew up with. Rewind makes some of the rougher moments much easier to deal with, and the games still look surprisingly good for their age. They definitely don’t all hit the same way, but that also kept the collection interesting from one game to the next. For a series about cavemen fighting dinosaurs, maybe expecting evolution to be completely straightforward was asking a bit much.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Oct 29, 2026
75
Video Chums
Joe & Mac Retro Collection is a solid compilation of a couple chaotic co-op games and a super-fun solo spin-off that'll have you bonking dinos with your club for hours. They may not be top-notch titles but a lot of love was poured into this package for sure.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Oct 29, 2026
75
Universo Nintendo
Joe & Mac Retro Collection misses the mark on fixing gameplay flaws and introducing an online mode, but it brings several extras to its gallery and a fun Boss Rush mode for every game in the compilation. For those who played it back in the day, it's a great way to relive this classic prehistoric adventure.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Oct 28, 2026
60
Nintendo News PL
A fairly safe dose of nostalgia for all those gaming cavemen out there. Every game has its own share of charm and imperfections. Surprisingly, it’s the second title - which was considered rather unusual back in the day - that might prove to be the most pleasant surprise today.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
Oct 28, 2026
60
Creative Bloq
A better collection than its headline game suggests. The original Joe & Mac is a charming but slight arcade conversion, but Congo’s Caper and Lost in the Tropics are the real draw, and rewind, save states, and Boss Rush make all three easy to dip into on Switch 2.
Nintendo Switch 2 FULL REVIEW
